subgroup_flags.classification_notes: The ptp target subgroup is inferred as absolute positive end-expiratory transpulmonary pressure because the paper cites Talmor's approach and aims for positive PL,EE; the exact computation method is not specified in the main text.

provenance.quote: statistical difference was found for EL (p<0.001, panel A and B)
PL,EI (p<0.001, panel E and F, p<0.00)

unclear_items: The unit for pO2 and pCO2 in Table 1 is reported as 'cmH2O', which is likely a typo for 'mmHg'.
The IQR for EL in AE-ILD-UIP at PEEPTITRATED is reported as '48.8 (59–42.8)' with the upper bound before the lower; interpreted as 42.8–59.
The method for transpulmonary pressure computation (PL = Paw - Pes) is not explicitly described in the main text; likely inferred from the Talmor reference.
Pairwise p-values in Figure 1 were read from the figure; some values may be approximate.
The study does not report a primary outcome; all physiologic variables treated as secondary.
data_only_in_figure: Pairwise p-values for EL, PL,EE, PL,EI, ΔPL from Figure 1
extraction_flags.general_notes: The study includes two groups: AE-ILD-UIP (n=10) and matched ARDS controls (n=10). The within-patient crossover compares three PEEP levels (ZEEP, PEEPLOW, PEEPTITRATED) within each group. The PEEPTITRATED condition is esophageal-pressure-guided. The study reports no clinical outcomes (mortality, length of stay) beyond a statement that all AE-ILD-UIP patients died during MV; this is not included as an outcome due to lack of a comparator arm label.
